name: Miyamae Mirai
source:
Mirai has a very kind personality, known for always smiling and never getting angry. She doesn't attend school for some reason, but is younger than protagonist. Mirai is poor and lives alone, therefore she has to provide for herself by working part-time at a family restaurant. 

[Translated from the game's [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20051215084453/http://www.russel.co.jp/hp/adult/trois/trois_chara.html]official website[/url]]
